metaTitle: Switch from Nightbot or StreamElements - ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Import your Twitch bot setup in minutes. The wizard brings commands, timers and quotes over from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot or Streamlabs Chatbot, and you review every item before it is written.
title: Bring your setup with you.
lead: Commands, timers and quotes come over from your current bot. You review every item before it lands.
step1Desc: Nightbot connects over OAuth. StreamElements, Moobot and Streamlabs Chatbot hand you an export file, and the wizard reads it right in the browser.
step2Desc: Every command, timer and quote is listed before it is written. Keep, skip, or adjust each one; nothing lands silently.
step3Desc: Approved items are written to your channel and the bot starts answering. Your old bot is untouched; retire it whenever you are ready.
src1Desc: Connects over OAuth, no file needed.
limitsNote: Export files are parsed in the browser; nothing is written to your channel until you approve it.
faqA1: Commands, timers and quotes. The wizard shows the full list from your export and you decide item by item.
faqQ2: Do I have to remove my old bot first?
faqA2: No. The import never touches your old bot. Run both while you test and part ways when you are ready.
faqQ3: Will my command responses survive the move?
faqA3: The wizard translates what it can into ItsBagelBot's variable system and shows you the result before anything is written, so nothing lands silently broken.
faqA4: Yes. The import wizard, like everything else, is part of the free tier.
ctaTitle: Two minutes and your setup is home.
